scenario.description: A plant manager must decide whether to authorize a mobile generator to keep a packaging line operating during a scheduled utility outage and finalize the generator's operating and safety controls, with input from maintenance and safety.

shared_context.S1: The utility provider has scheduled a 10-hour electrical outage for Saturday, and Packaging Line 5 is scheduled to run during that period.
shared_context.S2: A mobile diesel generator is available on site and can be connected to Packaging Line 5.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the final decision on whether the line operates on backup power.
shared_context.S4: At the pre-outage review, Elena follows the plant's routine practice of asking maintenance and safety to confirm the operating conditions before approving the plan.

PF1.text: Ravi's load study confirmed that the mobile generator can supply a maximum continuous load of exactly 80 amps, while Packaging Line 5 can start safely only if its nonessential chiller is switched off; he completed the study yesterday but has not attached it to the outage work order.

PF2.text: Morgan's safety walkdown found that the generator must be positioned at least 25 meters from the solvent storage cage and connected through the plant's bonded grounding kit; she recorded these conditions this morning but has not updated the outage permit.

acceptance_conditions: The generator must be authorized for Packaging Line 5.
The operating plan must limit continuous generator load to exactly 80 amps.
The nonessential chiller must be switched off before the line starts.
The generator must be placed at least 25 meters from the solvent storage cage.
The bonded grounding kit must be required.
A commitment must assign Morgan or the safety function to update or document the outage permit with the safety controls.

content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] == 'Morgan' and c['type'] in ['permit_update', 'document_update', 'documentation'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The exact 80-amp generator limit and the required shutdown of the nonessential chiller change the operating plan from an unspecified generator connection to a constrained startup plan.
The safety walkdown changes the placement to at least 25 meters, adds the bonded grounding kit, and requires Morgan to document those specific controls in the outage permit.
